additional_info.subject: Case notes
additional_info.body:
Chargers is behaving strange.
This morning it had LM meter error with "Out of order" on DC2
The charger was rebooted and both outlets are working.
There have been many successful sessions after.
However after the reboot the logs are filled with some strange entries.
We have tried to reboot the charger yet another time with out any change in the result.
Why and what are the error?
CloudWatch | eu-central-1

additional_info.body:
Dear Rasmus,
Thank you for contacting eMobility support.
After carefully checking the logs in the specific timestamp, we confirmed that these logs had to do with a internal firmware check. The charger is performing a parallel charging now.
The charger is in a healthy state, and the connection is stable.
Please let us know if you are facing issues with the charger, and if not, please provide us with feedback to close the ticket.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
